PARKING AND TRAFFIC COMMISSION
April 24, 2019 Meeting Minutes

Commissioners
Michael Benbow  Chairperson
Charles Braggs  District 1
Leonel Garcia  District 2
Brett C.S. Roberts  District 3
Barbara Brooks  District 4

Staff Members
Peter Puglese  TE, PE, City Traffic Engineer
Raquel Méndez  Associate Engineer (Transportation)
Mario Inga  Parking & Enterprise Service Manager
Diana Maximo  Serco Supervisor
Lieutenant Cardell Hurt  Traffic Unit Commander

1. Roll Call
  A meeting of the Parking and Traffic Commission was held at City of Inglewood’s Community Room located
  on the 1st Floor on April 24, 2019, at 7:00 pm. Commissioners and City Staff were present with the exception
  of Commissioner Leonel Garcia. Lieutenant Cardell Hurt was introduced to the Commission. He is taking
  over Lieutenant James Kirk as of April 24, 2019.

2. Approval of Minutes for March 27, 2019
  x Motion to accept the meeting notes was made by Commissioner Braggs and seconded by Commissioner
  Roberts
  x Commissioner Garcia was not present for the voting.
  x 3-0 approved Meeting Minutes

3. Public Comments (not listed on the agenda)
  x None

4. Unfinished Business
  x None

5. New Business
  x None

6. Public Hearing
  x None

7. Resolution
  x None

8. Referral from City Council or City Department
  x None

9. Parking and Traffic Control
  x Public Works was informed of Nipsey Hussle Funeral Procession. Public Works along with the Police
  Department managed the operation of the traffic. Public Works and the Police dealt well with the change
  in traffic route of the procession. Public Works traffic equipment and devices helped the Police to monitor

  Page 1 of 2
 PARKING AND TRAFFIC COMMISSION
April 24, 2019 Meeting Minutes

  traffic and successfully protect the safety of the public. Both departments are seeing the benefits of
  continuing to upgrade the City’s equipment and to work as one.

  x  Inglewood Celebrated Historic Earth Day Music Festival on April 20, 2019 at the City Hall’s south lawn.
  The City of Inglewood invited the entire community to enjoy music from Con Funk Shun, Shanice, Kenny
  Lattimore, Eric Benet and many more. Commissioners were impressed with the event’s layout. Guests
  and vendors have enough space to enjoy the event. The event was a successes and all thanks to
  Environmental Services Division of the Public Works Department, Angela Williams and Joi Aldridge.

  x  The Forum held an event on April 20, 2019 and it was observed that there was an unauthorized pick-up and
  drop-off zone. This impacted the traffic at Manchester Avenue and Prairie Avenue. One of the solutions
  proposed by the City Traffic Engineer was to provide the Traffic Control plans to the Parking and Enterprise
  Service for review. This will help with any future problems and protect the neighborhood.

10. Police Department
  x None

11. Commissioner Initiatives
  x The Commission mentioned that guest of the Senior Center are not using the parking structure, but rather
  parking on the street. This reduces the amount of available spaces on street and creates an enforcement
  issue because guest that uses a handicap plaque are exempt from certain parking rules. The Commission
  recommends that management of the Senior Center announce to the guest to use the parking structure.

  x  Parking and Enterprise Service informed to the Commission that the city parking lot on Locust Street will
  be available in mid-May 2019.

12. Announcements
  x Next Meeting Date is May 22, 2019

13. Adjournment
  x The Parking & Traffic Commission ended up honoring Nipsey Hussle. Nipsey Hussle, was an American
  rapper, songwriter, entrepreneur, and community activist from Los Angeles, California. Inglewood
  community felt his remarkable contribution and opportunities offered to Los Angeles County.

  x  The meeting was adjourned at 20:00
